narr: Isolated, slow moving showers and thunderstorms produced localized heavy rain and flooding.
ev: Flash flooding caused a mud slide near the corner of Stonelick Williams Corner Road and Mount Zion Road.
Several inches of water were flowing into an apartment building on South 5th Street and homes along South 6th Street. Numerous cars were also submerged in water.
lsr: Several inches of water entering into apartment units along South 5th street in Greenfield.
10 to 15 cars damaged due to flash flooding in apartment complex along South 5th Street.
Hudson Road washed out due to flash flooding.
